slices.focus: Caleb defends the concentrated corridor model against county budget pressure using conversion data, call-back logs, and a wall map with status dots
slices.summary: Fresh county budget pressure threatens to spread outreach hours back across a wider area. Caleb makes a direct case for the concentrated model using the scoreboard, call-back logs, and a wall map with status dots by household. Sharon helps frame it as a practical staffing argument rather than a personal project, and Caleb wins temporary protection for the corridor approach.
open_loops: Build one-page standing summary with three sections: conversion gained, drop-off reduced, staff touches required
Keep wall map current for fast reuse
